def eyes(f):
    e=sorted([(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S'])

def boxes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:

            rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]

def eyes(f):
    e=sorted([(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S'])

def boxes(f):
    out=[]

        if n['color']=='S':
            b=n['boundary']
            rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols)))
    return sorted(out)
